messages:
Jonah Reed: Hey folks, Im Jonah — starting as a Product Designer today. Small blocker: the Figma invite says "SSO required" and loops when I try to authenticate. Any quick fixes?
Mina Park: Welcome Jonah! :tada: Try accepting with your @redwood.com and open in an incognito window. If that fails, @Lena can add you via SCIM.
Jonah Reed: I accepted with my personal account first (my bad). Incognito opened the file but then Figma asked for org approval.
Lena Ortiz: Hey Jonah :wave: I just revoked the personal invite and resent an org invite to jonah.reed@redwood.com. You should be able to accept now. If not, DM me and Ill add you to the Product Designers group directly.
Jonah Reed: Got it, the org invite worked. I can see "Research backlog" and "Product roadmap - Q4". Thanks!
Andre Silva: Welcome! For research process, the canonical playbook is in Notion: Product > Playbooks > Research Sprints. Theres an interview guide + consent language there. If you need recruiter help, tag me and Ill loop them in.
Jonah Reed: Perfect — where do we keep the UX-to-eng handoff checklist? I usually attach a short checklist in the Figma file.
Mina Park: We keep the checklist in Notion under Product / Handoffs and add a Handoff page inside each Figma file. Ill DM you the template and the short dev checklist we use.
Lena Ortiz: Also join #design-system and the biweekly critique (Wednesdays 4pm). New designers present a quick deep-dive in week two if youd like feedback.
DesignOps Bot: :white_check_mark: Welcome package delivered for Jonah Reed. Onboarding tasks created: complete device setup, security training, join #design-system.
Jonah Reed: Thanks everyone  Ill copy the research template and set up a 1:1 with Andre for recruiting. Appreciate the quick help!
